elaine-sales: CareLoop wants a 14-day POC. Key asks: Private VPC in us-west-2, small dedicated pool (~100 rps), ephemeral hosted keys for a quick demo, audit log streaming to Splunk + S3 (12mo), BYOK KMS, and completed security questionnaire. Any red flags?

jordan-se: Clarify: full VPC peering with no public endpoints, right? Any EU residency concerns?

elaine-sales: Correct — full peering, US-only in us-west-2.

alex-platform: We can deploy a Private instance in us-west-2. Recommend 4-unit dedicated pool for predictability. Ephemeral hosted keys ok for the demo (scoped TTL + token caps). Need customer VPC CIDR and peer VPC id for infra ticket.

marco-security: For BYOK we need the KMS ARN and key policy to allow Redwood principal. Also confirm if prompts may include PHI — if so we should enable redaction pipeline and note in questionnaire.

sam-legal: CareLoop will need a short DPA and a SOW for the trial. I can produce a 14-day DPA + limited SOW. Need billing entity and signer contact.

elaine-sales: POC contact katie@careloop.ai; billing: CareLoop Inc. I'll DM marco the questionnaire and their Splunk HEC endpoint.

jordan-se: Ballpark pricing: dedicated pool ~$3.5k/week (dev discount), one-time setup ~ $1.2k. Autoscale off unless requested.

alex-platform: Creating ticket INFRA-4930 for Private POC (CareLoop) us-west-2. Items: 4-unit pool, VPC peering, Splunk HEC, S3 archive 365d, KMS BYOK. ETA ~72 hours after SOW signed.

marco-security: I'll start the questionnaire and pull evidence (sample audit export, admin logs). We default to redacting prompt content in exported artifacts unless customer permits raw content.

elaine-sales: Thanks — jordan please send quote; alex update ticket with rollout steps; sam draft DPA/SOW. I'll update CareLoop with timelines.

jordan-se: Will send quote today.

alex-platform: Confirmed ETA ~72 hours after approval.
